Since Kingambit is slower than Garchomp, Garchomp strikes first with Earthquake for roughly 120 damage, leaving Kingambit around 57-60 HP before it retaliates with Kowtow Cleave for a potential near-KO on Garchomp. I also need to factor in Rough Skin recoil damage to Kingambit from the contact move.

Checking Gholdengo as an alternative: it survives an Earthquake hit with its 164 HP pool even against near-max rolls, leaving it with enough HP to counter with Shadow Ball to take down Garchomp.
